      "question": "Reachability: the card says the cloud shelf pipeline runs this script, but it is not in the npm tarball (files: dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md) and has no bin, so only a checkout of objectstack-ai/objectstack can run it (`pnpm install` plus a build of the closure, because the script imports operationActionKey from src).       "question": "The inlining cut is lossy by necessity, so its default needs a decision. At depth 2 a DocuSign envelopeDefinition body keeps recipients but stubs signer (a typed object leaf with an explanatory description).",

        "C: separate budgets for inputs (parameters, request bodies) and outputs (responses), so action inputs stay deeper. More flags and code."
      ],
      "recommendation": "A, because it keeps two named levels of every body and response at a size the provider loads in about 0.6 s. Revisit C if authors report missing body fields."
    },

      "question": "Swagger 2.0 operations with an empty consumes list (DocuSign: 187 of 414): the script refuses by default and fills them only with --empty-consumes MEDIA_TYPE. Should the default be to auto-fill with application/json instead?",

        "B: auto-fill application/json and report the count. Friendlier, but it silently guesses a vendor's media type."
      ],
      "recommendation": "A, because a guessed media type is the silent-wrong class this script exists to remove, and the refusal names the operations and the flag."
    }

This PR deliberately does not hoist them for 3.x input (no workaround of a generator defect). · dedupe words: path-level parameters, path item parameters, inputSchema missing path parameter, collectOperations, openapi generator parameters",
